notes.title: The Clown's Forest 1.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today I have released The Clown's Forest Update 1.4.0!

Exciting new content is here and I will run through some of the major ones.

Update 1.4.0 Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Prologue - I have expanded the Prologue to feature a flashback sequence.

[*] New Locations - I have added some new locations such as a Medical Room and a Study to the game

[*] New Puzzle - I made a new puzzle for the newly added Study location. Get that brain ready!

[*] New Characters - New characters enter the fray to prepare for an upcoming spin-off title! Cody and Amelia Fox, Michael's adopted older siblings are now officially in the game.

[*] Two new endings - I have added two new endings to the game which brings the total of endings up to 12! Explore around to find the new ones!

[*] Collectibles - Despite already having notes, I have changed the lore, added more notes, but also added Blitzo Figurines, there is 33 to collect throughout the game!

[*] Updated Map Layouts - I updated pre-existing maps for them to look better, run smoother, and overall provide a better experience! (I removed being able to cheese Blitzo in the basement)

[*] Updated Puzzle Solutions - I added some new solutions to the Boathouse and Clock puzzle, upon loading up the game, there game will randomly select a number out of 3 numbers. It acts as a Seed. and will change the puzzles accordingly.

[*] Updated Dialogue - All dialogue has been rewritten to provide a better experience and a more compelling story.

[*] Updated Amusement Park Cutscene - I updated the Amusement Park cutscene with a better looking map, better dialogue, and more 'lore' to make it feel like a much more crucial moment in the story.

[*] Updated Voice Acting - All voice acting for the update was redone for the newly written dialogue and such.

[*] Fixed Spelling Mistakes - Most spelling mistakes have been removed and fixed up. With better puncturation and such.

[*] Fixed Lag in some locations - Some of the bigger maps had issues with lag, I have since optimized these locations to make them run smoother for the future console ports.
[/list]

This is just some of what is in the update! Some extra QoL features are present as well as some extra additions which I will let you guy's experience. Enjoy this new update to The Clown's Forest!

(All achievements have been updated too)

notes.title: The Clown's Forest Update 1.4.0 Announcement & Achievements being deleted
notes.notes:
[b]Happy February everyone![/b]

I apologise for the radio silence for the past few months, in relation to The Clown's Forest news that is. 

I promise you though it is for a fantastic reason.
[i][b]The Clown's Forest: Update 1.4.0[/b][/i]

This Update will include a ton of new features that I am very excited to share with you today before it releases in Q2 2025!

I will only tell you about some of the major changes I have done in this update, why this update came to be despite me saying the previous content update was the last one, and what is going on with the future of the series. 

So here is the changelog for the upcoming content update!

Update 1.4.0
[list]
[*] [b]New Locations[/b] - Some new locations were added in this update to add more 'lore' to the game and to tie it into later instalments in the series.

[*] [b]New Characters[/b] - New Characters enter in with ties to later titles and even spin offs! Even some references to unseen characters yet to be introduced

[*] [b]Updated Story[/b] - The story had to go under some revision as I added new locations and characters, and I decided to make the story not too different, but different enough to capture some interest!

[*] [b]Redone Voice Acting[/b] - Due to my lack of writing experience the original voice acting from the 1.3.0 update wasn't something I was too proud of, so with this update, I got the voice acting completely redone with rewritten dialogue to make the story feel that much more compelling.

[*] [b]Two new endings[/b] - While yes the original game had 10 endings, this update adds 2 more into the mix, bringing the total up to 12! Oh boy, ain't that exciting?

[*] [b]New Collectibles[/b] - For those who, like me, tends to explore every inch of a game map to find secrets, I have now added new collectibles. Whether that be story-related notes, or Blitzo the Clown figurines, there is plenty of secrets for everyone.

[*] [b]Map Updates[/b] - Some of the old maps have been updated with new layouts to make the manor feel much bigger. Even some exterior maps were changes to help with detail, or to fix some confusion among players.

[*] [b]New Achievements[/b] - Stay tuned after this changelog to know what I truly mean about New Achievements. It may make some of you upset, but ultimately, it is for the better.

[*] [b]Puzzle Revision[/b] - Some puzzles, primarily the Boathouse and Clock puzzles have been completely remade to have a more 'fresh' feel every playthrough. I have even added another puzzle into the game.

[*] [b]Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/b] - Now this is a gimmick that applies to every update to a game. But primarily some of the map updates in this game had to be done for optimization purposes. More on that down below
[/list]

And that is just a few of the changes for this update. Even that is a lot I must admit!

But don't go anywhere just yet. Before I get to explaining why this update came to be, I will explain a bit about the achievements.

The Clown's Forest's current achievements will be deleted and replaced with completely new achievements, that will temporarily be hidden from view to you all. This is for the fact that a lot of the achievements in the game right now, don't fit in with the new direction. That being said, these achievements will add plenty of new excitement to those who yearn to collect them all!

Some of these achievements will be unhidden when the update fully drops.

And now to explain why The Clown's Forest Update 1.4.0 became a thing despite saying 1.3.0 would be the last content update.

A couple months ago, I got into contact with a console publisher. (I won't name them yet) We got talking about the game, and what is in the game. They played through TCF and were super interested into porting the game to select consoles. (Again not naming what consoles currently as plans can change) When talking about some of the stuff in the game, some concern cropped up about some lag related to Blitzo's Pathing and also overuse of some events in certain maps (Namely the Library having over 80 Events)

Thus we eventually decided that I should update the game to include some optimization fixes for the game and to also try and fix some of the frame issues with Blitzo's chases.

I then decided to take this time to reflect on what else I could change in the update and ultimately decided to change up the game a bit to fit in with a better storyline not just for use in the overhaul of The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows, but for the other games, The Clown's Forest 3: Haunting Apparitions, The Clown's Forest: Fear of a Survivor, and even The Clown's Forest 4. 

I have already got TCF4 fully planned out and ready, so I can now start retroactively adding stuff to fit in with the overall story for the series.

That said, The Clown's Forest console ports haven't started development yet, as this update stills needs to be finalized before the publisher can start work.

I will definitely keep you all updated on when the Console Ports start development, and when you could expect it!

Anyway, I think this is already a pretty lengthy announcement!

I will see you all very soon!
- SilentWraith

notes.title: The Clown's Forest: Fear of a Survivor - ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
The Clown's Forest: Fear of a Survivor is an upcoming spin-off title set just after The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows.

You play as 17-year-old Sarah Baines as she wakes up in Hartown Amusement Park, more specifically, the House of Horrors! Sarah had just survived an indirect attack by Blitzo the Clown who had lured her to the basement of a fishing hut.

Waking up, she finds herself scared and alone, and she needs to work out how to escape the hell she has found herself in. Unfortunately for her, Chester is not too far away, twisting the house of horrors to a literal death trap. Help Sarah try and escape Hartown Park alive!

You can wishlist the game here! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753650/The_Clowns_Forest_Fear_of_a_Survivor/

notes.title: What's happening to The Clown's Forest 2?
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! I hope you are all having a fantastic Sunday so far! 

So I will need to clear up a few things about The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows to you all as I have been silently doing edits to the page behind the scenes. So what gives?

Well, I will explain everything.

On Saturday 13th May, I told some of my close friends I was struggling with a hard choice. I wasn't happy with the initial direction of The Clown's Forest 2, but I couldn't fix the current version as it would have taken longer to fix it than making the game from scratch. My biggest issue with it was that it was a step back from the first game. There were no puzzles, barely any chases, and overall the quality of the level design was more or less lacking.

So ultimately my choice was "Continue on and make a product that no one would enjoy" or "Scrap all the progress on the game so far, and start the game from scratch" I chose the 2nd option.

The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows officially restarted development from scratch on Sunday 14th May. With a brand new approach I am dropping multiple campaigns, I cut out one of the playable characters, and focusing more on the Puzzles, Exploration, and even a new "Duo" Mechanic, where you can boost your Companion to higher ledges to look for items, or swap character when split up.

So far, I have been enjoying this version of the game, unfortunately this does mean the game is delayed into 2024. I ain't gonna give an estimated release window other than "Next Year" doing this allows me to perfect the game, allow my voice actors to take their time, and allow my composer to work on the music in his own time without the worry of rushing.

I hope this clears up the confusion if any on why the Release Date says 2024 instead of 2023, why screenshots looked different, and why the description of the game page was also changed.

I am excited to show off more about this version of the project, but for now, everyone will have to be patient with what I have cooking up!

I hope you are all having a fantastic weekend and I will update you all soon!

- SilentWraith

notes.title: What happened to The Demos?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Now this is a different post than I usually would make.

First off, The Clown's Forest: Waking Shadows is now "The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows" as I felt it would work better as a named instalment as it is important for later entries in the series, and if you miss out on this game, you might not understand stuff for the later games.

Now let's get on to the news about the Demos for the first game and the sequel.

So as you were aware, I uploaded the Demo to The Clown's Forest last year, 1 month before the game's release. Recently I accidentally took it down. Upon trying to re-upload the Demo, I came across an issue that I cannot fix as there is no obvious reason why this is happening. But when I uploaded the first game's Demo again, (By just making it visible) The game would NOT install the Demo, instead, it tried installing a build of the full game, despite the fact the build of the full game Is not tied to the "Download Demo" Button. I haven't been able to figure it out, and google has no mention of this issue.

Cut to last week when I tried uploading The Clown's Forest 2's Demo to steam, I ran into the same problem. The only downloadable build should be the Demo, but again, it tried downloading a non-existent build of the full game. making it unplayable. I am not sure WHY it is doing this. If anyone has any ideas, please do not hesitate to message me!

All in all, I am still working heavily on The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows, and I am excited to get this game into your hands, even if I cannot get the demo out any time soon.

Apologies for this inconvenience!

I will try and get both demos back up as soon as I can! 

Thank you for your continued support for The Clown's Forest! Blitzo is excited to see you all very soon!

notes.title: Plans for The Clown's Forest for 2023
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It is now spring and that means I have some exciting news regarding the series.

I will be talking about all my plans in detail but here is a list of everything I will be covering in this post.

[olist]
[*]The Clown's Forest 2.1 Voice Acting Update
[*]The Clown's Forest: Waking Shadows - NIGHTMARE DEMO announcement
[*]A new game in The Clown's Forest series is in development
[*]The Clown's Forest 2: Shadows of Blood News
[/olist]

Okay so now this list is out of the way, let us start with the first game's upcoming content update!

The Clown's Forest's 2.1 Update is to contain Voice Acting. Initially, this was planned to release in the 2.0 Overhaul update, but some scheduling conflicts for the voice actors meant I couldn't hit that deadline for the voice acting. I can confidently say, the update will be released sometime this year. It will be a whole new way to experience the game with some really good actors bringing the characters to life with emotional and professional line delivery! I am excited to get this update out to you guys!

-

Now let's talk about The Clown's Forest: Waking Shadows - NIGHTMARE DEMO, so when I was moving this game to a standalone product rather than a DLC, I had been contemplating whether or not I should even make a demo, to me, it would be the perfect way to allow people to experience the game before purchasing the full title when it eventually drops later this year.

The NIGHTMARE Demo is going to be a little portion of Michael's campaign from the full game of Waking Shadows. Since Saturday the 18th, Michael was never planned to be playable in Waking Shadows, but I felt it would be beneficial to have a story with him included. His story is set within a nightmare world, where everything is distorted, broken, and bloody, and the fear of Blitzo is ever more present. Looming danger lurks in every corner of Michael's mind, and Blitzo is still a threat. Can Michael escape this nightmare?

The Demo is due to drop in Q2 2023.

-

Now, let us talk about another upcoming project. The Clown's Forest: Tokens of Insanity. 

This game is a spin-off that isn't a survival horror title. You play as Jonathan Longhurst, who is trapped in his own mind. You are stuck having to run around distorted levels, collecting Arcade Tokens from his old amusement park "Hartown Amusement Park" but he isn't alone, Every level will contain threats that will ruthlessly hunt him down and try to kill him. It will be the first game to be made outside of RPG Maker. 

The Clown's Forest: Tokens of Insanity is powered by Unreal Engine 4, and is due for release sometime in 2024.

-

Now last but not least, The Clown's Forest 2: Shadows of Blood.

Not much to really talk about for this game, except that it is gonna be taking longer to develop. The game is aiming to be big and will bring a new perspective to the story of The Clown's Forest.

It will be a full 3D title developed in Unreal Engine 5 and will feature not only Michael but 2 other playable campaigns. I cannot estimate a release window for this game. I am sorry if that does let some of you down, but I'd rather make the 2nd game the best it can possibly be!

-

That is everything that is taking place in 2023! I am confident about these projects, and I am very excited to show more about them soon! When I have more to announce, I will put up another post!

Thank you all for the support! And I am hoping to see you in the forest again soon!

- Ash

notes.title: The Clown's Forest: Waking Shadows GAME ANNOUNCEMENT

Hello everyone, the other month I initially mentioned an upcoming DLC to the first game named "Waking Shadows" I can now confirm that it is no longer going to be DLC! 

The Clown's Forest: Waking Shadows is now an official title in the series following two protagonists one day after the events of The Clown's Forest 1.

You play as either Carla Stevens or James Barlow a day after the events of the first game, they hear of the events of the previous night from Michael Longhurst, James despite being skeptical, joins Carla to investigate the park, which is a bad idea if you have watched Horror Movies or other Horror Games.

They split up onto their own paths. But what they both find out will chill them to the bone.

The game is made in RPG Maker MZ and features new locations, new characters, new stories, new mechanics, and much much more!

Wishlist the game on steam now! The game is slated for a late 2023 release!

More news on The Clown's Forest 2 is to come in the coming months as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2340330/The_Clowns_Forest_Waking_Shadows/

Thank you for reading this update post!

notes.title: The Clown's Forest: OVERHAUL UPDATE
notes.notes:
Here you are everyone! The biggest, and one of the final major updates to the game! This update adds so much to the base game (If you still have a save in the game, delete it as it will no longer work, or save over it with a new game) Here is the changelog:

Changes in the Overhaul update:
- added a Journal System
- added new maps
- added a new intro
- added more chases
- added permadeath mode
- added more flashbacks
- added new puzzles
- added a warning screen
- added new characters
- added new endings
- added a memorial to my friend

- removed mouse movement/interaction
- removed an ending that unobtainable

- changed story and dialogue
- changed the intensity of the main menu static
- changed the viper interactive bootup screen
- changed the normal difficulty to easy, and hard difficulty to normal
- changed statue puzzle to  actually be dangerous
- changed the way the endings work and how they are written

This update is meant to give the game a new breath of life to tie into a bigger story for The Clown's Forest 2. The original release of the game was intended to be a one-off, which meant it was harder to lead into a sequel.

Hope you all have a Merry Christmas and a happy new year!

- Viper Interactive

notes.title: What's next for The Clown's Forest?
notes.notes:
I have been out of the Loop for a while, but I can confirm I have been hard at work with some cool upcoming content for the series. [b]The Clown's Forest 2.0 Title Update[/b], and [b]The Clown's Forest 2[/b]!

But before I can talk about the sequel, Let me first tell you about the next Update for The Clown's Forest!

[b]The Clown's Forest Title Update 2.0 [/b] will be the biggest update for the game yet; featuring new characters, areas, and flashback sequences, as well as an overhaul of the Story itself, and incidentally will feature voice acting and even some quality of life improvements!
Here is a list of everything you should expect from the 2.0 Overhaul Update:
[olist]
[*] Added - Journal System
[*] Added - New Maps
[*] Added - New Intro
[*] Added - Voice Acting
[*] Added - New Chases
[*] Added - New Puzzles
[*] Added - Insane Difficulty
[*] Added - Flashback Sequences
[*] Added - New Characters
[*] Changed - Dialogue & Story Elements
[*] Changed - Viper Interactive Logo
[*] Fixed - Softlock at the end of the game
[/olist]
The 2.0 Update is coming soon and I will update you when I am ready to show more![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559528/332ea8c59e83b4f68f8c44a9f6bf912ed66c70a4.png[/img]

Now onto news about the sequel; [b]The Clown's Forest 2[/b]!

[b]The Clown's Forest 2[/b] is set 4 months after the first game, following a new Protagonist called Sarah! Sarah is a freelance journalist investigating Hartown Forest after claims of killer clown sightings! Everything seems normal for Sarah, until she digs too deep, and unleashes the horrors that try to kill her.

[b]The Clown's Forest 2[/b] will feature combat, New puzzles, New areas, New antagonists, and much much more! Improving on everything from the first game while also keeping in line with what made The Clown's Forest Identity! The Sequel is set to release sometime in 2023

Here is a Sneak Peek at the Logo: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42559528/fb3d9d223fadc2cdfbcc4ddde146992571f7a5a5.png[/img]

notes.title: The Clown's Forest coming July 22nd!
notes.notes:
The Clown's Forest's full game will be released on July 22nd! After extensive testing and changes to some of the game, I can officially say it is releasing on the 22nd! It's been 5 months since I started development of this game, and I can say it was worth it!

The Demo has officially been re-released after running into some issues with it earlier on.

Bug fixes for the demo and the game can be reported through the page's community discussions on the officially pinned bug fixes chat!

I thank everyone for their patience for the game, and I am looking forward to getting this game into your hands!

notes.title: Demo Issues
notes.notes: Hey everyone! If you noticed, I have taken the DEMO down off Steam temporarily, as I was trying to add a patch to the Steam Page, it gave me too many errors, which eventually also corrupted the main build of the demo itself, so, unfortunately, I had to take the Demo down, while I work on a way to fix the Demo's download! Sorry for this inconvenience! I will update you all once the demo is available to be downloaded again!

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes:
I have now officially released The Clown's Forest Demo! You can now download and play the demo on Steam!

I am working hard on the full game! and there might be a high chance the game could come out before October 31st! I will keep you all updated on the Development process!
